_doc: FightCamp sounds (S385). events: what the game plays (SoundBank.gd reads it); files: each asset, its Ludo prompt and numbers. heard=false until the operator keeps it on the sound board.

assets/audio/fight/punch_jab_head_1.ogg.prompt: A single quick boxing jab landing on an opponent's face: tight leather glove slap on skin, crisp and short, close microphone, dry, no crowd, no music

assets/audio/fight/punch_power_head_1.og.prompt: A heavy boxing cross or hook landing flush on the head: deep leather glove impact with a low thud and a sharp crack, powerful, close microphone, no crowd, no music

assets/audio/fight/punch_body_1.ogg.prompt: A boxing hook to the body landing on the ribs: dull heavy leather thump into the torso with a short exhaled grunt, close microphone, no crowd, no music

assets/audio/fight/punch_blocked_1.ogg.prompt: A boxing punch blocked by the opponent's gloves and forearms: padded leather glove hitting glove, muffled double pat, lighter than a clean hit, no crowd, no music

assets/audio/fight/punch_miss_1.ogg.prompt: A fast boxing punch that misses: short air whoosh of a glove and arm cutting through the air, with a sharp nasal exhale from the boxer, no impact, no crowd
